title: Document requirements for advertiser verification - Brunei - Advertising Policies Help

facts.fact: For Brunei, the documents required for advertiser verification depend on whether the Google Ads account type is 'Organisation' or 'Individual'.
facts.quote: The documents required are based on your account type 'Organisation' or 'Individual'.

facts.fact: In Brunei, organisations may be required to provide two types of documentation: organisation registration documents and a government-issued photo ID from an authorised representative.
facts.quote: Organisations** may be required to provide two different types of documentation for advertiser verification

facts.fact: In Brunei, only government departments and agencies may submit an official letter including full name, address and date as a registration document.
facts.quote: Only for government departments and agencies: an official letter including full name, address and date

facts.fact: An authorised representative for verification is an admin of the Google Ads account and/or the payments profile paying for the ads, and their government-issued photo ID can be issued in any country.
facts.quote: An authorised representative is an admin of the Google Ads account and/or the payments profile paying for the ads. The government-issued photo ID can be issued in any country.

facts.fact: Individuals in Brunei must submit a Bruneian government-issued photo ID issued as part of the verification programme, with accepted types being passport, national ID card, driving licence or residence permit.
facts.quote: Individuals** must submit a Bruneian government-issued photo ID issued as part of the verification programme.

facts.fact: In certain cases, individuals in Brunei may need a second proof-of-address document, such as a utility, phone or internet bill or bank statement dated within the last 60 days.
facts.quote: A utility (for example, electricity, gas, water) or phone or Internet bill (with a date in the last 60 days)

facts.fact: A bank statement used as proof of address for Brunei verification must be dated within the last 60 days.
facts.quote: A bank statement (with a date in the last 60 days)

facts.fact: Submitted personal data and documents for advertiser verification are not shared with any third party, according to Google's stated policy.
facts.quote: Personal data and documents won't be shared with any third party, as per the Google data protection policy

facts.fact: The details in submitted verification documents must exactly match the payments profile info, including the organisation name where applicable.
facts.quote: Make sure that the details in the submitted documents exactly match your payments profile info, including the organisation name, if applicable.
